shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -c 'set -eu
PORT=3148 node server.js >/tmp/little-library-restart.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
for attempt in $(seq 1 40); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3148/api/books >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done
BOOK_ID=$(curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3148/api/books -H '"'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"title\":\"Restart check\",\"author\":\"Test Reader\",\"notes\":\"This note survived.\"}' | node -p \"JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8')).id\")
kill \""'$SERVER_PID"
wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
PORT=3148 node server.js >/tmp/little-library-restart.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
for attempt in $(seq 1 40); do if curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:3148/api/books/$BOOK_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done
curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:3148/api/books/$BOOK_ID" | node -e "let input='"'';process.stdin.on('data',chunk=>input+=chunk).on('end',()=>{const book=JSON.parse(input);if(book.title"'!=='"'Restart check'||book.notes"'!=='"'This note survived.')process.exit(1);console.log('Restart persistence: passed')})\"
curl -fsS -X DELETE \"http://127.0.0.1:3148/api/books/"'$BOOK_ID" -o /dev/null
kill "$SERVER_PID"
wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
node --check server.js
node --check public/app.js
git diff --check
git status --short'

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,34p' package-lock.json && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- ignored paths ---\\n' && cat .gitignore && printf '\\n--- server process ---\\n' && pgrep -af 'node server.js' || true && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.git'"'"
/bin/bash -c 'npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --offline && node --check server.js && node --check public/app.js && git diff --check && git status --short'

/bin/bash -c "rg -n '\"start\"|dataFile|async function saveBooks|function renderDetail|function loadDetail|A NEW CHAPTER|shelf-panel|#books|Run it' package.json server.js public/app.js public/index.html public/styles.css README.md"
